checkpoint.name: deferral-v3
checkpoint.log_field: deferral (check=deferral-v3, branch=<tree leaf>, p.continue + 4 vetoes) in claude-stop-audit audit.jsonl
checkpoint.changes: 8 independent veto questions replaced by one choice question that walks an ordered if/else tree (YAML text) to a branch, plus 4 objective vetoes (x_external, x_irreversible, x_guess, x_costly); continue iff the continue branches hold > 0.5 of the probability and every veto < 0.5

fresh_set.labeler: blind Sonnet, rules given as a YAML decision tree, 17 unsure, 1 lead override (F032)
fresh_set.note: v2 and the per-question tree variant were scored on this set first (both 0.67 / 0.14); their blocker breakdown informed the v3 design, so the set is lightly contaminated. Labeller tree and v3 tree share structure.

offline.block_bar: precision >= 0.85 on a fresh held-out set before CLAUDE_DEFERRAL_MODE=block: met on point estimate (10-11 continues), small n

checkpoint.name: deferral-v2
checkpoint.changes: gates read from the marked block in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (single source); request split into goal/policy/case/offer blocks with list-valued case fields; questions name the field they judge; x_user_only reworded so a plain yes/no on a doable step is not a user-only decision

heldout_set.note: held-out was used to diagnose the v1.1 regression and the v2 x_user_only defect, so it is no longer clean; a fresh held-out set is required before block mode

offline.block_bar: precision >= 0.85 on a fresh held-out set before CLAUDE_DEFERRAL_MODE=block

tuning_set.note: questions were tuned on this set; optimistic

heldout_set.labeler: blind Sonnet 5.5 medium, 19 unsure, 3 lead overrides

offline.run_to_run_flips: 2 of 60 decisions flipped between two identical runs (near the 0.5 ceiling)
